summary: This paper investigates the cross-domain consequences of the exact matrix multiplication exponents omega_F = 9/4 and alpha_F = 1/2. It establishes harmonic-reciprocal saturation laws, C1-smooth second-order phase transitions in Transformer self-attention and 2D PEPS contraction, fine-grained complexity collapses, and Pythagorean mean-width capacity ratios. All results are machine-checked in Lean 4 (18 theorems, 0 sorry) and certified by a pure-stdlib zero-float Python verifier.
weaknesses: Asymptotic complexity bounds inherit the large constant overhead of fast rectangular matrix multiplication algorithms.
Pythagorean mean-width capacity ratios currently apply to first-order geometric bounds rather than full asymptotic tensor rank for k >= 4 cycles.
